svg.title: Airborne kite-energy system — Vindorka með flugdreka
svg.desc: A tethered soft wing connects to a ground-level generating drum and mounting base.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"power-airborne-wind","label_en":"Airborne kite-energy system","label_is":"Vindorka með flugdreka","section":"06","category_en":"Power plants and generation","category_is":"Orkuver og orkuframleiðsla","batch":3,"tags":["power","wind"],"description":"A tethered soft wing connects to a ground-level generating drum and mounting base.","design_note":"The tether ends at a generator drum, not a pilot harness, distinguishing kite-energy generation from paragliding.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
